expo.name: NIRVANA
expo.description: Northeast Intelligent Routing & Vehicle Accessibility Network Assistant

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NIRVANA uses the camera to report real-time road conditions, landslides, and blockages.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NIRVANA uses your location to geo-tag road incident reports in Northeast India.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NIRVANA needs photo library access to upload road status evidence.
